messages.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate your commitment to a binding volume and the offer of faster payment terms, which allow us to adjust our pricing. 

Based on the 14-day payment term and the increased volume, we can offer a revised price of EUR 368.68 per unit. Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that it is our strict company policy not to disclose internal cost structures. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Our current Angebot is a price of €368.68 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
